title: Garlic {p} Pasta with {v}
steps: Boil the {s} in well-salted water until just tender. Keep a cup of the water, then drain.
Warm the oil in a large skillet. Cook the {v} with the {spice} until soft and fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the {p} and cook until {doneness}, about 2 to 3 minutes. Pour in the {sauce} and let it bubble for a minute.
Toss in the {s}, adding splashes of the cooking water until glossy. Serve immediately.
tip: Use half the pasta and add more vegetables to the pan.
